title.narrative: Strengthening Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights in Angola

description.narrative:
The project seeks to increase the coverage of family planning/contraceptive services by using the Menstrual Health Management (MHM) as an entry point. UNFPA has past experience with MHM, especially with the introduction of reusable sanitary pads and behavioural change interventions with girls. The project will complement the actions of the Ministry of Education, which are being developed in 900 public schools in the (current) 18 provinces of the country, with technical support provided by UNFPA. The project also aims to reduce maternal mortality from haemorrhage by 50% through a misprostol study and training of 500 health professionals. The project also includes community mobilization efforts to address social gender norms that limit the realization of the sexual and reproductive rights of girls and young women. Moreover, as a third component, the project seeks to tackle the problem of gender-based violence in Angola.
The project will be implemented in five provinces: Bie, Cunene, Luanda, Malanje, and Namibe.
